title: feat(github): add github.org config key
body:
## Summary

Adds `org` to the GitHub plugin's `config-keys` alongside the existing `repo` key. This registers `github.org` as a valid config key, enabling install-wide defaults via `createApp({ configDefaults })` and channel-scoped overrides via `jr-rpc config set github.org <org>`.

Changes:
- `packages/junior-github/plugin.yaml` — added `org` to `config-keys`
- Updated test fixtures in `github-app-broker`, `capability-runtime`, and `config-defaults` tests to include `github.org`
- Updated docs (`config-and-env.md`) with `github.org` in the `configDefaults` example
- Updated `specs/providers/catalog-spec.md` to list `github.org` in the GitHub provider definition

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] Verify `github.org` can be set via `jr-rpc config set github.org myorg` and retrieved via `jr-rpc config get github.org` in a running instance
- [ ] Verify `createApp({ configDefaults: { "github.org": "myorg" } })` works without errors

### Notes

Pre-existing typecheck failure in `apps/example/server.ts` (`configDefaults` not in `JuniorAppOptions`) — not introduced by this PR.
